note.question: How should resources in shared micromobility systems (bike sharing and scooter sharing) be managed?
note.overview: The model considers the problem of managing resources in shared micromobility systems (bike sharing and scooter sharing). An important task in managing such systems is periodic repositioning/recharging/sourcing of units to avoid stockouts or excess inventory at nodes with unbalanced flows. The model considers a discrete-time model; each period begins with an initial inventory at each node in the network, and then, customers (demand) materialize at the nodes.
